canvas.note: True-neutral paper (the green cast went on 29 Sep 2026). The page, the rail, the quiet ground.

surface-sunken.note: Secondary button fill, row hover, the filled search field, the locked ground.

line-subtle.note: Where two regions meet: row and row, header and body, list and pane.

line.note: The pane's left rule, a menu's border, the neutral chip, the secondary button's hover; at 70 % inset it is the `edge` shadow.

brand-tint.note: Inside the app shell ([data-shell]) app/ds.css remaps this to accent-tint.

brand-tint-strong.note: Inside the app shell remapped to accent-tint-strong.

brand-ink.note: Inside the app shell remapped to accent-ink: links in the buyer app are near-black: `.link` in app/ds.css sets this colour and a 1px `line-strong` underline at 3px offset that darkens to currentColor on hover. A link marked by an arrow or chevron underlines on hover only. A name in a list (a supplier in an RFQ table, a document title) is `ink-strong`, not link ink, and underlines on hover at the same 3px offset, which [data-shell] sets and every element inherits.

brand-ink-inverse.note: Inside the app shell remapped to ink-inverse (#F2F4EE): a toast's link is the inverse ink with the `.link` underline, not Spring Green.

focus.note: Inside the app shell remapped to accent: the buyer app's focus ring is near-black.

accent.note: No hue (founder, 29 Sep 2026: "use different shades of black and white"; it was slate that morning): the near-black mark on the focus ring, the tab indicator (the current status tab chip's 2px bottom rule, CURRENT_TAB in chips.tsx, its count in ink-muted), the selected bar (the current nav row's and a selected card's 3px rule; the current Settings row's, 2px under it on a phone and 3px at its start from md) and the ticked box. Inside [data-shell] text selection is inverted: `accent` ground with `accent-on` text. Facts' icons are `ink-muted`.

accent-ink.note: Link text (with the `.link` underline), a selected label, the current nav row's text, a menu's active check.

accent-tint.note: A selected row, the current nav row, the open account row. #E9E9E6, not line-subtle's #E7E7E4, so an ink-subtle caption on it passes 4.5:1.

accent-tint-strong.note: A set filter menu, the `on` chip.

locked.note: A plain ground; the 135-degree stripe went on 29 Sep 2026.

headline.purpose: Heading component default (22/30, 500); the record name in the sheet.

headline-sm.purpose: Every section heading inside the record sheet (18/26, 500).

title.purpose: A card's name, a tab, the wordmark (15/22, 500; 16/24 inside the app shell). A name in it is one line (the One-Line Name Rule).

body.purpose: Default text and fact values (14/22, 400; 15/24 inside the app shell).

label.purpose: Buttons, nav, fact labels, table cells, chips (13/20, 500; 14/20 inside the app shell).

caption.purpose: Notes, read dates, badge text (12/16; 13/18 inside the app shell) in ink-subtle.

code.purpose: Register and certificate numbers, HS codes (13/20 mono; 14/20 inside the app shell).

eyebrow.purpose: A column key or a stat's label, table headers; 11/16 mono uppercase +0.08em (12/16 inside the app shell). A data label, never a kicker above a heading.

stat.purpose: The big figure in a stat block (22/30, 400).

shadows.name: xs
shadows.purpose: The topbar search field on focus.

shadows.name: md
shadows.purpose: Everything that floats over the page: a Menu, the account menu, the typeahead list, the bulk bar, a Reason note.

shadows.name: lg
shadows.purpose: The record sheet and the toast.

shadows.name: edge
shadows.purpose: The soft edge of a secondary button, a segmented control, the results panel and an outlined section. Draws inside the box, takes no layout.

shadows.name: glass
shadows.purpose: Defined for frosted panels; the .glass utility (surface at 80% + 16px blur) is used without it.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: A control's colour, border, shadow and 2% press.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: A rise (8px up) and the sheet sliding in 32px from the right.

motion.name: ease-in
motion.purpose: Defined; exits land at once, so unused.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: app/ds.css zeroes every duration under prefers-reduced-motion; components also set motion-reduce:animate-none.

appTypeScale.scope: [data-shell] (the buyer app), through --ds-fs-* / --ds-lh-* variables; the marketing site keeps the frontmatter sizes.
appTypeScale.caption: 13px / 18px
appTypeScale.label: 14px / 20px
appTypeScale.title: 16px / 24px

zIndexMeta.raised: The record's sticky tabs, a sticky table header, the topbar.
zIndexMeta.overlay: Every Menu, the account menu, a popover, a tooltip, the typeahead list.
zIndexMeta.modal: The onboarding tour's scrim and its card.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one brand-filled control on a screen, living in the pane (the record's Send RFQ, the composer's Send), never on every row. Inside the app shell focus is the near-black ring.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The workhorse, drawn by tone not outline: surface-sunken with the inset edge; hover fills line. Save, Open, Export, a row's RFQ.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Text only in ink-muted; hover fills surface-sunken. Close, Back, a menu's summary, a row's icon actions at 28px.

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Filled (founder's pick, 29 Sep 2026): surface-sunken with no outline and no shadow, line-subtle under the pointer; while typing it turns surface with a 1px line edge and a 2px ink-strong line under it. No green ring; the input draws no focus ring of its own.

narrative.overview:
The buyer app is a ledger of receipts. Every screen is a page of neutral paper (`canvas`) with white panels laid on it, grouped by tone and spacing rather than boxed, and every fact on the page has room beside it for the mark of the register that filed it. Density is desk-level: 13px labels, 14px body, 36px table rows, 32px controls, a 232px rail and a 56px frosted topbar. Colour is spent like money. The shell is near-monochrome on a neutral grey ramp, the brand green appears on the one primary action and the logo, and the hueless `accent` role (greys and near-black) carries selection, the current nav row, set filters, links, tabs and focus, with every fact's icon in `ink-muted`, and status hues (teal-green, amber, red, and the reserved sanction maroon) appear only on facts that carry that status.

The world refuses the competitor's chat-first home and its match-score theatre: there is no score, grade, rating or star anywhere on a buyer surface. It also refuses decoration: the one flourish is the `signal` dot, a bright green point beside a live number or in a toast, and the empty-state spot illustrations, single-weight ink line art with one brand-green fill. Motion is acknowledgement, not spectacle: entrances only, opacity-led, at 120 / 200 / 320 ms, and nothing is lost when the device asks for reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral paper canvas, white panels, depth by tone and spacing; a hairline only where two regions meet (a row and the next, a header and its body, the list and the pane).
Geist for words, Geist Mono for the ledger's stamps (register numbers, column keys, source marks, counts).

Brand green on the one primary action and the logo only; shades of grey and near-black carry selection, the current row, set filters, links, tabs and focus; the facts' icons are ink-muted. Green is never a badge or a state.
Source rank drawn as a neutral lightness ramp, so colour stays free for status.
Locked contact details sit on the plain locked ground, never blurred; empty and unverified are quiet, never alarming.
A company's name is one line in every list, row, card, menu and picker, cut at the end with the whole name on hover and in the record; its qualifier ("Unit-2") leads the line under it.
Entrances only: fade 200, rise 320, sheet-in 320; exits land at once. The record opens beside the results, both live: no scrim, nothing modal.

Everything secondary opens in the pane beside the list it came from: the record, a product line, the RFQ composer, the filters, save search, an order, an RFQ. The shell and the buyer's search never move; Close returns to them. A page of its own exists only for a deep link.

The app opens on the search landing (`/app`): one large field, one-click filters, the common searches as templates with live counts, the buyer's saved searches, and no supplier listed until the buyer asks (founder, 28 Sep 2026). The desk that was Home (certificate alerts, recent activity) sits at the top of Saved.

The list is a ledger grid first: 40px rows, sortable sticky headers that meet the top of their scroll region, row actions always drawn in a column of their own, and the keyboard. The thumbnail cards are the other stop of the switch.
SourceBD's own line icons (24px grid, 1.5px stroke, round ends) beside facts, in ink-muted; Phosphor for verbs.
Six named stacking layers; every Menu floats at z-overlay (200).

rules.name: The Spent Green Rule
rules.body: In the buyer app, solid brand green appears on two things: the primary action and the logo. Selection, the current nav row, a set filter, links, tabs, focus and the ticked box take the hueless `accent` role (greys and near-black); inside `[data-shell]` the green tints and link ink (`brand-tint`, `brand-tint-strong`, `brand-ink`) and `focus` are remapped to it in `app/ds.css`, so older classes follow. Green is never a badge fill, a chip tone or a state colour, so it can never be read as "verified".

rules.name: The Reserved Maroon Rule
rules.body: `sanction` is used for a sanctioned supplier and nothing else. Errors use `danger`; the two are never interchanged.

rules.name: The Quiet Absence Rule
rules.body: No proof is not a warning. Unverified facts and empty lists sit on `quiet` with `quiet-ink` and a dashed `quiet-line`; they never take caution or danger.

rules.name: The Monochrome Rank Rule
rules.body: Source trust is drawn in lightness on the ink ramp, never in hue. The mark's accessible name carries the tier in words.

rules.name: The One File Rule
rules.body: Every colour in the app is a token from `lib/design/tokens.ts`, reached through a Tailwind class. Tailwind's stock palette is replaced, not extended; a hand-typed hex or rgba in a component is a defect.

rules.name: The Grey Fact Rule
rules.body: A fact's icon is SourceBD's own (`SbIcon`) in `ink-muted`, like its label; the facts carry no colour; the label is `ink-muted`, the value `ink-strong`. Status hues stay on status; a fact row whose model carries no icon fails a test.

rules.name: The One-Line Name Rule
rules.body: In every list, table row, card title, menu, picker and suggestion, a company's or a building's name is one line, cut at the end with an ellipsis (`OneLine`, or `truncate` on a `min-w-0` box). The whole name stays in the DOM and in `title`; a row's accessible name is the whole name. The qualifier (a unit, a building, a division, a former name) moves to the second line. Everything that is not a name (a chip, a fact value, a caption, a register's words) still wraps and is never cut; `data-name` marks the name elements the guards exempt.

rules.name: The Stamp Rule
rules.body: Mono is for what a register filed, not for emphasis: reference numbers, codes, counts, column keys, the two-letter marks. Body text is never mono.

rules.name: The Light Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings and company names are weight 500. Weight 600 appears on the page `h1`, section titles and the remediation figure only; 700 is unused in the app.

rules.name: The Tone First Rule
rules.body: Regions separate by tone and spacing; a 1px `line-subtle` draws only where two regions truly meet (row and row, header and body, list and pane). A box inside a box is a defect: a section's panel is `surface` on `canvas` with no border, and the things inside it (tiles, stats, chips, buttons) take tone, not outlines. A shadow means something floats over the page: an overlay takes `md`, the toast `lg`.

rules.name: The Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is `ink-strong` at low alpha. A neutral black shadow is not in the vocabulary.

rules.name: The Named Layer Rule
rules.body: Stacking is six named layers (`zIndex`: base 0, raised 10, sticky 100, overlay 200, modal 300, toast 400). The theme replaces Tailwind's numeric scale, so a numeric z class compiles to nothing; `tokens.test.ts` refuses a numeric or arbitrary z class in the buyer app. `<main>` and the results panel are `isolate`.

dos: **Do** reach every colour through a Tailwind token class (`bg-brand`, `text-ink-muted`); the only place a hex may be typed is `lib/design/tokens.ts`, and `tokens.test.ts` fails the build otherwise.

**Do** leave room beside every fact for its source mark and a link to the register; a row with no mark carries the pending icon (`SbIcon` "pending", a document with a clock), and the legend under the facts says "Source pending" once.

**Do** put a company's name on one line in a list, cut at the end, with the whole name in `title` and its qualifier on the line under it; let chips and values wrap (`overflow-wrap: anywhere` as the last resort).

**Do** keep entrances on the three lengths: 120 ms for a control's colour and press, 200 ms for a fade or the composer's scrim, 320 ms for a rise or the sheet; opacity leads every entrance and `both` fill keeps the element visible if the stylesheet fails.
**Do** pair `animate-*` with `motion-reduce:animate-none`; `ds.css` also zeroes every duration under `prefers-reduced-motion`, and nothing depends on a frame arriving.
**Do** draw the locked contact state on the plain `locked` ground with the count per kind of contact on file; the card claims only what the count says.

**Do** use SourceBD's own `SbIcon` set beside facts (in `ink-muted`) and Phosphor regular for verbs, at 16px (14px in a card's facts line, 12px inside a chip), and name an icon only when it is not decorative.
**Do** add any new text/background pair to `contrastPairs` before using it; an unlisted pair is unchecked.

**Do** format every date, time, amount and quantity through `lib/dashboard/facts.ts` (`formatDay` "12 May 2027", `formatTime` "12 Sep 2026, 14:30", `formatRelative` for a secondary caption only, `formatMoney` "6.15 USD", `formatQuantity` "12,000 pcs"); a locale-dependent `toLocaleDateString` is a defect.
**Do** put every floating layer on a named z layer (`z-overlay` for a Menu or a popover); never a numeric z class.
donts: **Don't** open a secondary interface as a page jump or a modal over the shell: it opens in the pane beside where the buyer is, and Close returns there.
**Don't** put a border round a panel on the canvas, or a box inside a box; group by tone and spacing.
**Don't** put a primary button on every row of a list; the one primary lives in the pane.
**Don't** show a score, grade, rating, star or percentage of fit on a buyer surface; the remediation percentage is a filed figure with its source, not a judgment.

**Don't** put brand green on a chip, badge, state, or fact; verified is `positive` teal, and the only green fills are the primary button and the logo; selection and the current nav row are greys and near-black.
**Don't** reuse `sanction` for an error, or `danger` for a sanction.
**Don't** blur, pixelate or grey out locked data; set the block on the locked ground and say what is held.
**Don't** colour an empty or unverified state with caution or danger; it sits on `quiet`.
**Don't** put a shadow on a row or a card in a list, or type a shadow by hand; the four-step ink-tinted vocabulary is the whole set.
**Don't** animate an exit or a loop for decoration; a close, a navigation and a dismiss land at once.
**Don't** let a company's name wrap inside a list row, or cut anything that is not a name: never cap a chip's height, or set `white-space: nowrap` on a register's words.
**Don't** set mono on body text, or 600 on a heading that the `Heading` component draws at 500.

**Don't** add a package for anything the kit already draws (icons are SourceBD's own `SbIcon` set and Phosphor, fonts are self-hosted Geist, illustrations are cleaned SVGs in `public/illustrations/`).
